messages.author: 31f2a4a0c7dcca4a
messages.subject: shinyApp statement
parts:
Hi all,
Brand new to R and Shiny, and I'm trying to run an 'app' developed by a previous employee  What is the statement/syntax to 'knit' (run) an app with an init.R, ui.R, and server.R?

I have the below since the titles of the files are shinyUI and shinyServer, but it's clearly wrong:
shinyApp(ui= "shinyUI", server="shinyServer")

I'm getting the following error message:
Listening on http://127.0.0.1:xxxx
Error in get(fun, mode = "function", envir = parent.frame()) : 
  object 'shinyServer' of mode 'function' was not found

Thank you.

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] shinyApp statement
parts:
Welcome to R.  It is probably rough to get started by looking at someone else's application.  I would strongly encourage you to take a look at the tutorial and some of the articles at:  shiny.rstudio.com .  The tutorial will take you a couple of hours to get through, you could also watch a three part webinar we have posted here that will walk you through how Shiny works.  You don't really knit a shiny application.  You can run it by typing runApp() in the directory that has your app.R or your ui.R and server.R files.  

The discussion list that you will find particularly helpful for asking shiny related questions is the shiny-discuss list which provides support for what shiny is and how to use it.  shinyapps-users is a discussion list that is focused on helping people who are trying to deploy their shiny applications to the shinyapps.io cloud.

Best of luck,
Tareef
